title: A firewall drops the packets
fault: The injection adds an iptables DROP rule on the forwarded port.
prompts: Is the machine reachable at all?
What is the difference between a drop and a refusal?
hints: A timeout means the packets go somewhere and no answer comes back.
A refusal means something answered. A timeout means silence.

reveal.wrong: The injection dropped the packets on the forwarded port, so the client waits until its timeout.
reveal.fix: Examine the firewall rules on the path, and compare the timeout against the refusal you saw in other scenarios.
